storage.description: Persistence backend. SQL backends need a SqlClient at runtime.

tablePrefix.description: SQL table name prefix (must end with underscore).

defaultStatus.description: Status assigned to createUser when none is supplied.

deletionGracePeriodMs.description: Soft-delete grace period before purge (default 30 days).

deletionPolicy.description: How purgeExpired removes accounts after the grace period.

activityRetentionMs.description: Activity history retention used by pruneActivity (default 365 days).

acceptUrl.description: Invitation accept URL template. Use {token} or append ?token=.

appName.description: Name used in default invitation emails.
